description.fun: Legend says Regirock was made from rocks by Regigigas and sealed away by ancient people who came to fear its power. When it's damaged in battle, it repairs itself with new rocks, which is why it's a patchwork of stone from all over the world. Modern scans found it's made entirely of rock, with no heart or brain at all. The dots on its face may be inspired by Braille, which players had to read to find it in Ruby and Sapphire.
description.guide: A Rock-type Legendary Pokémon, one of the legendary giants, said to have been made by Regigigas from rocks and sealed away in ancient ruins. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A patchwork rock golem with no heart or brain
